verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a developer-focused email SaaS like MailerSend, so the axis applies. The evidence documents the Email API, SMTP relay, official language libraries and connections to AI tools like Claude, but none of these is a command-line interface. SDKs and AI-tool integrations are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
